scope_of_deliverables.quote: The consultant/proponent will be responsible for: Environment Review: Review the pre-prepared IT environment information, which outlines RDCK's system architecture, repositories, and workflows. Conduct targeted Q&A sessions with IT, Records Management (RM) staff, and operational managers to clarify environment details. Document any gaps or assumptions in the provided information that could impact migration readiness. SharePoint Migration Roadmap: Develop a structured migration road map that details: Best practices in modern information architecture design for SharePoint. Common pitfalls and risks and how to mitigate them. Recommendations on phasing the migration to minimize disruptions. Recommendations on required RDCK staff resources to complete the migration. Considerations of training, governance, security, and compliance. Licensing and Cost Analysis: Evaluate Microsoft Purview's licensing requirements and determine if it is the optimal solution for RDCK's records management. Provide cost estimates for: SharePoint implementation. Resource allocations for the implementation. Additional tools or services required for migration. Ongoing licensing and compliance costs. Records Management and Compliance Strategy: Determine whether Microsoft Purview aligns with RDCK's records management needs. Identify alternative solutions if Purview is not the best fit. Provide best practices for retention policies, metadata tagging, privacy management, and automated compliance tools. Outline governance models that support scalability and regulatory compliance.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Develop a SharePoint migration road map, identify challenges and risks, evaluate Microsoft Purview suitability, conduct environment review, provide licensing and cost analysis, and outline records management and compliance strategy.

insurance_requirements.quote: The Consultant must provide the RDCK with a certificate of insurance upon execution of this Agreement in a form acceptable to the Chief Financial Officer of the Regional District and shall, during the Term of this Agreement, take out and maintain the following insurance coverage: (i) comprehensive commercial general liability insurance against claims for bodily injury, death or property damage arising out of this Agreement or the provision of the Services in the amount of $ 2,000,000 dollars per occurrence with a maximum deductible of $5,000; (ii) professional liability coverage in the amount of $ 1,000,000 dollars per claim and with a maximum deductible of $50,000; (iii) Technology Errors and Omissions Insurance and Network Security in the amount of $2,000,000 dollars per occurrence; (iv) Data Liability Insurance in an amount of no less than $2 million;

value.coverage_type: Technology Errors and Omissions Insurance and Network Security

vendor_experience_required.quote: The firm's past project experience with assessing an organization's readiness for implementing SharePoint and creating a roadmap for an implementation.
